meta.name: game-research
meta.description: Structured game development research with solo-dev feasibility filtering. Use when investigating engines, genres, art styles, tools, or any game-dev decision. Wraps the research skill with game-specific framing. Outputs feed into decision-journal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理游戏开发选项并标注独立开发可行性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是独立开发者,正纠结用什么引擎、画风或工具
copy.tagline_en: Turn game-dev research into decision-ready summaries with solo-dev fit checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're an indie developer weighing engines, art styles, or tools.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以「单人开发者可行性」来过滤游戏开发研究:先查是否已有定论,再按依赖顺序调研引擎、美术风格等,最后给出可行性评级、学习投入和建议,并写入决策日志。
howto.when: 当你提出引擎、游戏类型、美术风格等游戏开发相关问题,或要做任何游戏开发决策时触发。

say.text: 帮我调研适合新手单人开发的 2D 引擎,考虑 Steam 发布。
say.note: Claude 会按依赖顺序研究并给出可行性评级。

say.text: 单人做像素美术风格游戏,学习成本高吗?
say.note: 会评估美术风格与工具的独游可行性。

say.text: 对比 Godot 和 Unity,哪个更适合独立新手?
say.note: 会对比能力、学习曲线、社区与成本。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude structures game-dev research through a solo-dev feasibility filter: it checks past decisions, researches in dependency order, then adds feasibility ratings, learning investment, and a recommendation, and records the outcome in the decision journal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you investigate engines, genres, art styles, tools, or any game-dev decision.

say_en.text: Research 2D engines for a beginner solo dev aiming at a Steam release.
say_en.note: Runs structured research with feasibility ratings.

say_en.text: Is a pixel-art style realistic for one person? Assess the learning cost.
say_en.note: Evaluates art style and tools for solo feasibility.

say_en.text: Compare Godot vs Unity for an indie beginner making 2D games.
say_en.note: Compares capability, learning curve, community, cost.
